		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_SVN.236.b
		trigger = { NOT = { COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_d_border_answer_valid = yes } }
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_SVN.236.b executed"
		hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_d_border_open }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = VIE } VIE = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SVN.436 } } }
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}
}

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_d_recog_signed

			add_ideas = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_the_coexistence_treaty
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_weekly_preview = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_weekly_preview = 0.30 }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_weekly_preview = 52 }
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SVN_weekly_0_03_tt
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.002 } }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes # IMPERIA COLD WAR — B9 MD standard: MD treasury line instead of a custom % of GDP tooltip
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_d_recog_activate = yes
			if = { limit = { COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_d_recog_active = yes } VIE = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SVN.637 } } }
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}

		name = COLDWAR_SVN.237.b

		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_SVN.511"
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_SVN.511.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_SVN.511.a executed"
		hidden_effect = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_a_rok_signed
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_a_rok_open
			clear_variable = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_a_rok_party
		}
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_korean_brigade_and_builders } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_korean_brigade_and_builders }
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}

	title = COLDWAR_SVN.603.t
	desc = COLDWAR_SVN.603.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal

	is_triggered_only = yes
	hidden = yes
	trigger = {
		tag = VIE
		COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_e_unite_active = yes
		NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_reunification_commission_partner }
	}

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_SVN.603"
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_SVN.603.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_SVN.603.a executed"
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_e_unite_paid } }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_e_unite_paid
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_vie_union
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = GAME_RULE_allow_colored_puppets }
				set_autonomy = {
					target = SVN
					autonomy_state = autonomy_autonomous_state_colored
					end_wars = no
					end_civil_wars = no
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_autonomy = {
					target = SVN
					autonomy_state = autonomy_autonomous_state
					end_wars = no
					end_civil_wars = no
				}
			}
		}
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_reunification_commission_partner
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_e_unite_announced } }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_e_unite_announced

	title = COLDWAR_SVN.630.t
	desc = COLDWAR_SVN.630.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal

	is_triggered_only = yes
	hidden = yes
	trigger = {
		tag = CBD
		COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_c_rep_active = yes
		NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_ethnic_tension_eased }
	}

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_SVN.630"
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_SVN.630.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_SVN.630.a executed"
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_c_rep_paid } }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_c_rep_paid
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.0005 } }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_ethnic_tension_eased
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_c_rep_announced } }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_c_rep_announced
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SVN.1030 }
		}
	}
}

# Offer 3 (prg_e_unite): notice to the partner that the agreement is in force
country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_SVN.1003
	title = COLDWAR_SVN.1003.t
	desc = COLDWAR_SVN.1003.d
	picture = GFX_treaty

	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = { tag = VIE }

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_SVN.1003"
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_SVN.1003.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_SVN.1003.a executed"
		effect_tooltip = {
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_reunification_commission_partner
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = GAME_RULE_allow_colored_puppets }
				set_autonomy = {
					target = SVN
					autonomy_state = autonomy_autonomous_state_colored
					end_wars = no
					end_civil_wars = no
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_autonomy = {
					target = SVN
					autonomy_state = autonomy_autonomous_state
					end_wars = no
					end_civil_wars = no
				}
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}
}
